notes.content: SDSU offers mirrored programs at SDSU Imperial Valley, located in Calexico, CA. These programs are available through Transfer Success Pathway (TSP), a new program offering guaranteed admission to eligible students. Due to high demand, admission to SDSU is highly competitive. General admission information is available at: http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/admissions/transfers/index.html
